changes.title: AWS Key Management Service now supports ML-KEM for post-quantum key encapsulation
changes.detail: AWS Key Management Service (KMS) now supports Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM), a post-quantum cryptography standard under NIST FIPS 203 , which enables two parties to establish a shared secret. NIST designed ML-KEM to replace the classical key-establishment schemes, like DH/ECDH key agreement, and RSA-based key transport, in their strategic cryptographic roadmap (see NIST IR 8547 ). ML-KEM addresses the "harvest now, decrypt later" threat to those classical schemes, where an adversary records the key-establishment exchange today and recovers the shared secret once suf
